rituals.game_move: PLAY: Score Odds → Weigh Evidence → Follow Evidence
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Score Odds → Weigh Evidence → Follow Evidence

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Score Odds — Give the prediction a number from 0 to 100. Odds Receipt — press feet.
2. Check Baseline — Find one relevant base rate: how often has this happened in similar situations?
3. Weigh Evidence — Notice one fact that raises the odds and another that lowers them. Odds Receipt — camera check.
4. Revise Odds — Issue a revised number and date it.
5. Follow Evidence — Act from the revision, not the original alarm. Odds Receipt — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Follow Evidence.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
rituals.formula_flow: Score Odds → Check Baseline → Weigh Evidence → Revise Odds → Follow Evidence
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
End the count if numbers become reassurance checking or you cannot stop recalculating.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.name: THE BAD VOICE ACTOR
rituals.hook: Watch: Authority often hides inside delivery.
rituals.hook_internal: Watch: Authority often hides inside delivery.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Read Wrong → Keep Words → Replay
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Read Wrong → Keep Words → Replay
rituals.goal: Authority often hides inside delivery.
rituals.mission: Authority often hides inside delivery.
rituals.challenge: Authority often hides inside delivery.
rituals.immediate_need: Authority often hides inside delivery.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Authority often hides inside delivery.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Read Wrong — Hear the thought as a tired GPS, an overdramatic sports commentator, or a hesitant intern reading the wrong memo. Bad Voice — widen gaze.
2. Keep Words — Keep the words unchanged; alter only tempo, pitch, and confidence. Bad Voice — allow opposite.
3. Replay — Then replay it in your natural voice as a possibility, not an order. Bad Voice — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Replay.

rituals.title: EDIT THE FONT, NOT YOURSELF
rituals.name: EDIT THE FONT, NOT YOURSELF
rituals.hook: Shift: A thought displayed differently can be held differently.
rituals.hook_internal: Shift: A thought displayed differently can be held differently.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Project → Move Metres → Read Version
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Project → Move Metres → Read Version
rituals.goal: A thought displayed differently can be held differently.
rituals.mission: A thought displayed differently can be held differently.
rituals.challenge: A thought displayed differently can be held differently.
rituals.immediate_need: A thought displayed differently can be held differently.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A thought displayed differently can be held differently.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Project — Project the sentence on an inner screen. Edit Font — press feet.
2. Shrink — Shrink it to caption size.
3. Move Metres — Move it two metres away. Edit Font — allow opposite.
4. Lower Opacity — Lower opacity, swap the heavy typeface for something ordinary, and place generous blank space around it.
5. Read Version — Read the edited version once, then look at real text nearby. Edit Font — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Read Version.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.name: RETURN WITHOUT A TRIAL
rituals.hook: Switch: Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.
rituals.hook_internal: Switch: Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: State Off → Name Value → Skip Verdict
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: State Off → Name Value → Skip Verdict
rituals.goal: Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.
rituals.mission: Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.
rituals.challenge: Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.
rituals.immediate_need: Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Drift needs a direction change, not a prosecution.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. State Off — State what moved off course in plain language. Return Without — widen gaze.
2. Delete — Delete every adjective about your character.
3. Name Value — Name the value still available and take its nearest next action. Return Without — split duty.
4. Move Whether — Only after moving, decide whether the plan needs repair.
5. Skip Verdict — Skip Verdict verdict is required for re-entry. Return Without — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Skip Verdict.

rituals.name: DROP THE APPEAL
rituals.hook: Peek: Reality has already entered the Hold in your mind.
rituals.hook_internal: Peek: Reality has already entered the Hold in your mind.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: State Fact → Remove Approval → Add Nothing

rituals.challenge: Reality has already entered the Hold in your mind.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Self-blame, guilt & shame

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Reality has already entered the Hold in your mind.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. State Fact — State the fact in plain past or present tense. Drop Appeal — feel support.
2. Remove Approval — Remove approval, blame, and every ‘should not have happened.’ Notice the body’s protest and answer, ‘Not liking it is allowed. Drop Appeal — split duty.
3. Add Nothing — Refusing its existence adds nothing.’ Choose the next response available in the world that actually exists. Drop Appeal — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Add Nothing.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I separated blame from what can actually be repaired.
rituals.formula_flow: State Fact → Remove Approval → Add Nothing
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Acceptance must never be used to legitimise abuse, injustice, or preventable harm.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Switch: Acceptance is often a direction repeated, not a mood achieved.

rituals.challenge: Acceptance is often a direction repeated, not a mood achieved.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Acceptance is often a direction repeated, not a mood achieved.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Catch Mind — Catch the mind reopening the case against what has already occurred. Turn Again — press feet.
2. Name Refusal — Name the refusal without criticism.
3. Rotate Attention — Rotate attention toward the existing fact and the action now possible. Turn Again — split duty.
4. Return Wheel — Each return is one turn of the wheel; stop counting after the chosen behaviour begins. Turn Again — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Return Wheel.

rituals.safety:
PAUSE
If repeated turning becomes compulsive, step away and use ordinary support.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Positive events need appointments, not vague hope.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Genuinely — Choose one genuinely reinforcing experience; assign it a time, place, and first action. Put Good — press feet.
2. Protect Appointment — Protect the appointment from unnecessary multitasking.
3. Details — While it happens, notice three details worth encoding. Put Good — name feeling.
4. Afterward — Afterward, resist grading whether you enjoyed it ‘enough.’. Put Good — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Afterward.

GOAL
Regulation can be built by travelling, not staying still.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Find Activated — Find one activated region and another settled or supported area. Pendulum Between — hear sound.
2. Move Resource — Touch the difficult region with attention for a few seconds, then move to the resource.

4. Finish Whichever — Finish on whichever location offers steadier awareness of your location. Pendulum Between — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Finish Whichever.

rituals.hook: Catch: Some experience forms before it can be explained.

rituals.goal: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
rituals.mission: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
rituals.challenge: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
rituals.immediate_need: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Some experience forms before it can be explained.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Bring Mind — Bring the issue to mind lightly, then pause verbal analysis. Wait Whole — breathe naturally.
2. Ask Body — Ask the body, ‘What is the whole of this like?’ Wait for an image, phrase, posture, or global texture.
3. Check Whether — Check whether it fits by noticing a small inner yes, no, or shift. Wait Whole — name sensation.
4. Leave It Raw — Leave the answer unpolished. Wait Whole — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Leave It Raw.

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Let external support do part of the holding.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Contact — Choose one contact point—feet, seat, back, forearms, or hands. Borrow Floor — widen gaze.
2. Release Extra — Increase pressure slightly, then release extra effort and notice what the surface continues to carry.
3. Name Texture — Name its texture, temperature, and steadiness. Borrow Floor — notice detail.
4. Trust Ground — You need not manufacture a sense of ground. Borrow Floor — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Trust Ground.

rituals.hook: Look: Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.
rituals.hook_internal: Look: Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Watch Swallow — After body alarm, watch for a swallow, sigh, warmth, trembling, yawn, moisture in the eyes, breath shift, or muscle release. Catch Recovery — hear sound.
2. Name Accurately — When one appears, name it accurately and stay with its after-effect.
3. No Extra Trigger — Do not provoke more. Catch Recovery — name sensation.
4. Look Like — Teach the mind what recovery looks like. Catch Recovery — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Look Like.

TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

GOAL
Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.

1. Watch Swallow — After body alarm, watch for a swallow, sigh, warmth, trembling, yawn, moisture in the eyes, breath shift, or muscle release. Catch Recovery — hear sound.
2. Name Accurately — When one appears, name it accurately and stay with its after-effect.
3. No Extra Trigger — Do not provoke more. Catch Recovery — name sensation.
4. Look Like — Teach the mind what recovery looks like. Catch Recovery — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Look Like.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.

FORMULA FLOW
Watch Swallow → Name Accurately → No Extra Trigger → Look Like

rituals.title: FIND THE BUSY HALF
rituals.name: FIND THE BUSY HALF
rituals.hook: Test: Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
rituals.hook_internal: Test: Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Observe Ordinary → Phase → Check Whether
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Observe Ordinary → Phase → Check Whether
rituals.goal: Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
rituals.mission: Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
rituals.challenge: Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
rituals.immediate_need: Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Observe Ordinary — Observe three ordinary cycles. Find Busy — move slowly.
2. Rate Inhale — Rate inhale effort and exhale release separately.
3. Phase — Which phase is working too hard?. Find Busy — find evidence.
4. Leave Timing — Ease only that side toward neutral—less pulling in or less pushing out—while leaving timing alone.
5. Check Whether — Check if urgency changes when imbalance decreases. Find Busy — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Check Whether.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
rituals.formula_flow: Observe Ordinary → Rate Inhale → Phase → Leave Timing → Check Whether
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Stop adjustment at the first sign of dizziness, strain, or breath fixation.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: ALTERNATE THE AIRWAY
rituals.name: ALTERNATE THE AIRWAY
rituals.hook: Catch: Move attention left and right until state feels organised.
rituals.hook_internal: Catch: Move attention left and right until state feels organised.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Sit Easy → Continue Unhurried → Finish Nostrils
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Sit Easy → Continue Unhurried → Finish Nostrils
rituals.goal: Move attention left and right until state feels organised.
rituals.mission: Move attention left and right until state feels organised.
rituals.challenge: Move attention left and right until state feels organised.
rituals.immediate_need: Move attention left and right until state feels organised.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Move attention left and right until state feels organised.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Sit Easy — Sit Easy Easy comfortably. Alternate Airway — soften shoulders.
2. Close Nostril — Without force, close one nostril and breathe through the other; switch sides for the next gentle cycle.
3. Continue Unhurried — Continue alternating with an unhurried hand. Alternate Airway — notice detail.
4. Keep Breath — Keep the breath quiet and abandon retention.
5. Finish Nostrils — Finish with both nostrils open. Alternate Airway — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Finish Nostrils.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can move attention left and right until state feels organised.
rituals.formula_flow: Sit Easy → Close Nostril → Continue Unhurried → Keep Breath → Finish Nostrils
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Skip when congested, dizzy, breath-sensitive, or advised against the practice.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Flip: Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.
rituals.hook_internal: Flip: Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Take Ordinary → Stop Empty → Listen Silence

rituals.mission: Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.
rituals.challenge: Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.
rituals.immediate_need: Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Take Ordinary — Take an ordinary inhale. Vibration Way — hear sound.
2. Leave Feeling — Hum at a soft, comfortable pitch as air leaves, feeling vibration in lips, face, or chest.
3. Stop Empty — Stop before empty. Vibration Way — name sensation.
4. Listen Silence — Listen to the silence after the hum, then decide whether another round would still feel kind. Vibration Way — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Listen Silence.

rituals.title: THE RETURN REP
rituals.name: THE RETURN REP
rituals.hook: Bet: Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.
rituals.hook_internal: Bet: Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Select Neutral → Count Rather → End After
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Select Neutral → Count Rather → End After
rituals.goal: Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.
rituals.mission: Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.
rituals.challenge: Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.
rituals.immediate_need: Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Select Neutral — Select one neutral anchor. Return Rep — loosen hands.
2. Attention — Each time distraction appears, notice where attention went and escort it back without commentary.
3. Count Rather — Count returns rather than uninterrupted seconds. Return Rep — allow opposite.
4. End After — Finish after ten honest comebacks, even if focus never felt perfect. Return Rep — next action.

⚡ FINISH — End After.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.
rituals.formula_flow: Select Neutral → Attention → Count Rather → End After
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Choose a broader practice if narrow focus increases agitation.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Watch: Visual absence does not need a replacement image.

rituals.goal: Visual absence does not need a replacement image.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Visual absence does not need a replacement image.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Set Darkness — In a safe darkened setting, notice darkness as the actual visual field. Let Darkness — press feet.

⚡ FINISH — Stay Briefly.

under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Look for thought at the moment of assembly.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Hold Attention — Hold attention quietly and wait. Before Sentence — soften shoulders.
2. Earliest — When a thought begins, notice its earliest form: pressure, fragment, image, word, or felt orientation in space.
3. No Backtracking — Do not chase backward after it fully forms. Before Sentence — notice detail.
4. Birth — Simply Notice ‘birth’ and let the completed thought continue. Before Sentence — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Birth.

PLAY TIME

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A thought’s disappearance is usually ignored.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Select Naturally — Select one naturally occurring thought. Follow Zero — hear sound.
2. Stay Wording — Stay with its exact wording or image as it alters, fragments, loses relevance, or is replaced.
3. Identify Instant — Spot the first instant when no trace can be found. Follow Zero — allow opposite.
4. Let It End — Do not resurrect it to verify the ending. Follow Zero — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let It End.

rituals.hook: Bet: Ongoing sense is built from linked renewals.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Choose Attention → Return Repetition → Chain

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Ongoing sense is built from linked renewals.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Attention — Choose one attentional act small enough to repeat daily. Return Chain — feel support.
2. Set Cue — Define its cue, duration, and Keep Notice.
3. Return Repetition — Each session begins with the final second of yesterday’s intention: ‘return again.’ Protect repetition from heroic increases. Return Chain — notice detail.
4. Chain — A chain is made of modest links. Return Chain — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Chain.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.challenge: Effort is yours; total control was never issued.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Effort is yours; total control was never issued.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Action — Name the action within your responsibility. Return Outcome — feel support.
2. Name Result — Name the result you cannot command.
3. Use Language — Offer the second to God, life, reality, community, or a principle larger than ego—using language authentic to you. Return Outcome — pick action.
4. Perform — Then perform the first with full care. Return Outcome — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Perform.

rituals.title: TRACE THE FIRST SPARK
rituals.name: TRACE THE FIRST SPARK
rituals.hook: Switch: Find what started the fluctuation before content took over.
rituals.hook_internal: Switch: Find what started the fluctuation before content took over.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Take Recurring → Stop Earliest → Future
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Take Recurring → Stop Earliest → Future
rituals.goal: Find what started the fluctuation before content took over.
rituals.mission: Find what started the fluctuation before content took over.
rituals.challenge: Find what started the fluctuation before content took over.
rituals.immediate_need: Find what started the fluctuation before content took over.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Find what started the fluctuation before content took over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Take Recurring — Take one recurring state and move backward through its chain: current thought, preceding sensation, image, memory, external cue, and hidden tendency. Trace First — press feet.
2. Stop Earliest — Stop at the earliest condition you can genuinely spot. Trace First — name feeling.
3. Future — Notice the point where future interruption could happen. Trace First — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Future.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can find what started the fluctuation before content took over.
rituals.formula_flow: Take Recurring → Stop Earliest → Future
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Do not force inaccessible memories or invent causes to complete the chain.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: NOT THIS, STILL HERE
rituals.name: NOT THIS, STILL HERE
rituals.hook: Twist: Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.hook_internal: Twist: Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Body → Keep Perspective → Rest Unlabelled
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Body → Keep Perspective → Rest Unlabelled
rituals.goal: Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.mission: Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.challenge: Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.immediate_need: Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Body — Notice body, sensation, thought, emotion, and role in turn. Still Here — breathe naturally.
2. Keep Perspective — For each say, ‘Observed—therefore not the whole observer.’ Do not claim they are unreal. Still Here — name sensation.
3. Rest Unlabelled — After the sequence, rest with what remains unlabelled, then reconnect to name and place. Still Here — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Rest Unlabelled.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Remove identities without attacking experience.
rituals.formula_flow: Body → Keep Perspective → Rest Unlabelled
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid negation practices during feeling unreal or disconnected, psychosis, or unstable self-experience.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: FIND WHERE THE PATTERN MISSED
rituals.name: FIND WHERE THE PATTERN MISSED
rituals.hook: Test: A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.
rituals.hook_internal: Test: A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name Pattern → Compare Conditions → Transplant Edge
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Name Pattern → Compare Conditions → Transplant Edge
rituals.goal: A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.
rituals.mission: A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.
rituals.challenge: A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.
rituals.immediate_need: A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Pattern — Name the recurring pattern in one line, including the trigger and usual response. Find Where — hear sound.
2. Find Misses — Find two occasions when the same kind of trigger produced no pattern or a clearly weaker version.
3. Compare Conditions — Compare the exceptions. Spot one shared condition that you can influence: timing, preparation, company, distance, information, or body care. Find Where — notice detail.
4. Transplant Edge — Place that condition into the next comparable situation and define what weaker would look like. Find Where — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Transplant Edge.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ A pattern is less inevitable once you find where it already failed to appear.
rituals.formula_flow: Name Pattern → Find Misses → Compare Conditions → Transplant Edge
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Exceptions do not make unsafe situations safe; do not use this game to blame yourself for trauma, illness, abuse, discrimination, or coercion.

rituals.title: DIFFERENCE INSIDE ONE FIELD
rituals.name: DIFFERENCE INSIDE ONE FIELD
rituals.hook: Shift: Diversity need not become division.
rituals.hook_internal: Shift: Diversity need not become division.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Contrasting → Include Shared → Let Difference
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Contrasting → Include Shared → Let Difference
rituals.goal: Diversity need not become division.
rituals.mission: Diversity need not become division.
rituals.challenge: Diversity need not become division.
rituals.immediate_need: Diversity need not become division.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Diversity need not become division.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Contrasting — Notice two contrasting experiences—pleasant and painful, self and other, sound and silence. Difference Inside — widen gaze.
2. Hold Distinct — Hold their distinct qualities without merging them.
3. Include Shared — Then include the shared field in which both are present. Difference Inside — notice detail.
4. Let Difference — Let difference remain vivid without translating it into separation. Difference Inside — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Difference.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Diversity need not become division.
rituals.formula_flow: Contrasting → Hold Distinct → Include Shared → Let Difference

PAUSE

rituals.title: MOVE THE HEAVIEST WORD
rituals.name: MOVE THE HEAVIEST WORD
rituals.hook: Imagine: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
rituals.hook_internal: Imagine: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Say Alarm → Find Weight → Keep Signal
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Say Alarm → Find Weight → Keep Signal
rituals.goal: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
rituals.mission: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
rituals.challenge: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
rituals.immediate_need: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Say Alarm — Choose the exact alarm sentence and shorten it to seven phrasing or fewer. Move Heaviest — feel support.
2. Shift Stress — Say it quietly several times, moving emphasis to one different word per round. Keep pitch and speed comfortable.
3. Find Weight — Notice which emphasis changes the meaning or body response most. Focus only on that word. Move Heaviest — notice detail.
4. Keep Signal — Keep the weighted word as information; stop the repetitions without debating the whole sentence. Move Heaviest — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Signal.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
rituals.formula_flow: Say Alarm → Shift Stress → Find Weight → Keep Signal
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Use silent emphasis if speaking is unsafe; stop for voice strain, breathing difficulty, or rising panic.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.name: MEANING ON HOLD
rituals.hook: Probe: Meaning must wait for independent witnesses.
rituals.hook_internal: Probe: Meaning must wait for independent witnesses.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Hold Event → Name Meaning → Assign Narrowest
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Hold Event → Name Meaning → Assign Narrowest
rituals.goal: Meaning must wait for independent witnesses.
rituals.mission: Meaning must wait for independent witnesses.
rituals.challenge: Meaning must wait for independent witnesses.
rituals.immediate_need: Meaning must wait for independent witnesses.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Meaning must wait for independent witnesses.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Hold Event — Hold the event without explaining it. Meaning Hold — hear sound.
2. Find Facts — Find three facts from different channels—what was said, what was observed, what occurred over time.
3. Name Meaning — Until all three exist, Name every meaning temporary. Meaning Hold — notice detail.
4. Assign Narrowest — Then assign the narrowest meaning supported. Meaning Hold — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Assign Narrowest.

✓ Meaning must wait for independent witnesses.

rituals.hook: Switch: Compress the noise without pretending it is solved.
rituals.hook_internal: Switch: Compress the noise without pretending it is solved.

rituals.goal: Compress the noise without pretending it is solved.

rituals.challenge: Compress the noise without pretending it is solved.
rituals.immediate_need: Compress the noise without pretending it is solved.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Uncertainty & reassurance seeking

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Compress the noise without pretending it is solved.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Temporary — Choose a temporary word that holds the issue: betrayal, pressure, uncertainty, loss. Word Breath — press feet.
2. Say During — Say it once during a natural breath, feel its weight, and let the word leave with the breath’s end. Word Breath — allow opposite.
3. Keep One Name — Do not replace it with a second Name for thirty seconds. Word Breath — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep One Name.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Sort Three Boxes — Picture three boxes: KNOWN, INFERRED, UNKNOWABLE. Come Back — feel support.
2. Move Claim — Move every claim about the other person into its correct box.
3. Choose Direct — Choose one direct question or boundary based on known facts. Come Back — split duty.
4. Leave Unknowable — Leave the unknowable box empty of action. Come Back — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Leave Unknowable.

rituals.name: SOFT JAW, SAME BOUNDARY
rituals.hook: Check: Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.
rituals.hook_internal: Check: Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Notice Jaw → Deliver Limit → Let Articulation
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Notice Jaw → Deliver Limit → Let Articulation
rituals.goal: Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.
rituals.mission: Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.
rituals.challenge: Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.
rituals.immediate_need: Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Notice Jaw — Notice jaw pressure before speaking. Soft Jaw — press feet.
2. Separate Teeth — Separate the teeth, relax the tongue, and exhale naturally.
3. Deliver Limit — Deliver the exact limit you planned—no extra smile, apology, or attack. Soft Jaw — split duty.
4. Let Articulation — Let articulation stay clear while muscular threat signalling drops. Soft Jaw — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Articulation.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ Reduce aggression preparation without weakening the sentence.

rituals.name: FINISH THE BODY'S FULL STOP
rituals.hook: Switch: Let leftover readiness complete one harmless ending.
rituals.hook_internal: Switch: Let leftover readiness complete one harmless ending.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Find Readiness → Complete Slowly → Check Neutral
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Find Readiness → Complete Slowly → Check Neutral
rituals.goal: Let leftover readiness complete one harmless ending.
rituals.mission: Let leftover readiness complete one harmless ending.
rituals.challenge: Let leftover readiness complete one harmless ending.
rituals.immediate_need: Let leftover readiness complete one harmless ending.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Let leftover readiness complete one harmless ending.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Find Readiness — While safely seated, locate one area that still feels ready to push, brace, turn, or withdraw. Finish Body — press feet.
2. Add Resistance — Choose a pain-free direction and add only light self-resistance.
3. Complete Slowly — Complete the movement slowly once, then release all effort rather than repeating it. Finish Body — name feeling.
4. Check Neutral — Compare resting pressure, movement range, and urge before and after. Finish Body — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Check Neutral.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can let leftover readiness complete one harmless ending.
rituals.formula_flow: Find Readiness → Add Resistance → Complete Slowly → Check Neutral

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

TRIGGER

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Short-term attention needs a deliberate admission policy.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Create Positions — Create three positions: ACTIVE, WAITING, ARCHIVE. Active Slot — widen gaze.
2. Wait Route — Put only one concern in active, one likely next item in waiting, and route everything else to archive with a retrieval Notice. Active Slot — notice detail.
3. Give Active — Give the active concern a protected time box. Active Slot — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Give Active.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Hold Sensation → Give Attention → Focus

rituals.goal: Foreground and background can share equal status.
rituals.mission: Foreground and background can share equal status.
rituals.challenge: Foreground and background can share equal status.
rituals.immediate_need: Foreground and background can share equal status.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Observer loss & cognitive fusion

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Foreground and background can share equal status.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Hold Sensation — Hold the dominant sensation or thought with three background what you notices—one sound, one contact point, one visual feature. Demote Headline — soften shoulders.
2. Give Attention — For a contained interval, give all four equal attentional weight without imagining a separate watcher. Demote Headline — notice detail.
3. Focus — Notice how centrality changes. Demote Headline — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Focus.

items.hook: Watch: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.

items.game_move: PLAY: Score Odds → Weigh Evidence → Follow Evidence

items.goal: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
items.mission: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
items.challenge: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
items.immediate_need: Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Fear speaks in certainty; reality keeps percentages.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Score Odds — Give the prediction a number from 0 to 100. Odds Receipt — press feet.
2. Check Baseline — Find one relevant base rate: how often has this happened in similar situations?
3. Weigh Evidence — Notice one fact that raises the odds and another that lowers them. Odds Receipt — camera check.
4. Revise Odds — Issue a revised number and date it.
5. Follow Evidence — Act from the revision, not the original alarm. Odds Receipt — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Follow Evidence.

GOAL
Authority often hides inside delivery.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Read Wrong — Hear the thought as a tired GPS, an overdramatic sports commentator, or a hesitant intern reading the wrong memo. Bad Voice — widen gaze.
2. Keep Words — Keep the words unchanged; alter only tempo, pitch, and confidence. Bad Voice — allow opposite.
3. Replay — Then replay it in your natural voice as a possibility, not an order. Bad Voice — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Replay.

1. Select Safe — Select a safe body region. Tension Exit — loosen hands.

Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Acceptance is often a direction repeated, not a mood achieved.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Catch Mind — Catch the mind reopening the case against what has already occurred. Turn Again — press feet.
2. Name Refusal — Name the refusal without criticism.
3. Rotate Attention — Rotate attention toward the existing fact and the action now possible. Turn Again — split duty.
4. Return Wheel — Each return is one turn of the wheel; stop counting after the chosen behaviour begins. Turn Again — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Return Wheel.

items.hook: Test: Regulation can be built by travelling, not staying still.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Regulation can be built by travelling, not staying still.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Find Activated — Find one activated region and another settled or supported area. Pendulum Between — hear sound.
2. Move Resource — Touch the difficult region with attention for a few seconds, then move to the resource.
3. Travel — Travel back and forth at a pace that preserves choice. Pendulum Between — name sensation.
4. Finish Whichever — Finish on whichever location offers steadier awareness of your location. Pendulum Between — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Finish Whichever.

items.name: WAIT FOR THE WHOLE BODY ANSWER
items.ritual_name: WAIT FOR THE WHOLE BODY ANSWER
items.hook: Catch: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
items.hook_internal: Catch: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
items.game_move: PLAY: Bring Mind → Check Whether → Leave It Raw
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Bring Mind → Check Whether → Leave It Raw
items.goal: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
items.mission: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
items.challenge: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
items.immediate_need: Some experience forms before it can be explained.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Some experience forms before it can be explained.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Bring Mind — Bring the issue to mind lightly, then pause verbal analysis. Wait Whole — breathe naturally.
2. Ask Body — Ask the body, ‘What is the whole of this like?’ Wait for an image, phrase, posture, or global texture.
3. Check Whether — Check whether it fits by noticing a small inner yes, no, or shift. Wait Whole — name sensation.
4. Leave It Raw — Leave the answer unpolished. Wait Whole — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Leave It Raw.

End the inquiry if bodily attention creates panic, numbness, or feeling unreal or disconnected.

items.game_move: PLAY: Small → Stop Completion → Observe Whether
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Small → Stop Completion → Observe Whether
items.goal: An interrupted protective move may still be waiting.
items.mission: An interrupted protective move may still be waiting.
items.challenge: An interrupted protective move may still be waiting.
items.immediate_need: An interrupted protective move may still be waiting.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
An interrupted protective move may still be waiting.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Small — Notice the small impulse to push, turn, step back, shield, or say no. Complete Defence — move slowly.
2. Let Unfold — In a safe space, let it unfold slowly at ten percent strength.
3. Stop Completion — Stop at the natural completion and return to neutral posture. Complete Defence — name feeling.
4. Observe Whether — Observe whether the body receives an ending. Complete Defence — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Observe Whether.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Use Object — Using an object, doorway, or trusted person with consent, test near and far in small increments. Find Body — loosen hands.
2. Breath — Notice breath, posture, urge, and clarity at each point.
3. Body — Notice where the body can stay present and communicate. Find Body — name feeling.
4. Distance — That distance is data, not a permanent verdict. Find Body — next action.

items.hook: Look: Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.
items.hook_internal: Look: Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.

items.goal: Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.
items.mission: Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.
items.challenge: Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.
items.immediate_need: Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Settling deserves as much attention as alarm.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Watch Swallow — After body alarm, watch for a swallow, sigh, warmth, trembling, yawn, moisture in the eyes, breath shift, or muscle release. Catch Recovery — hear sound.
2. Name Accurately — When one appears, name it accurately and stay with its after-effect.
3. No Extra Trigger — Do not provoke more. Catch Recovery — name sensation.
4. Look Like — Teach the mind what recovery looks like. Catch Recovery — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Look Like.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Scan Head — Scan from head to feet for remaining body alarm. Close Body — widen gaze.
2. Select Strongest — Select the strongest residue and give it one stabilising response: support, movement, warmth, grounding in the present, or rest.

4. State Today — State what is complete today and what belongs to later care. Close Body — next action.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Not every unsettled breath needs a longer exhale.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Observe Ordinary — Observe three ordinary cycles. Find Busy — move slowly.
2. Rate Inhale — Rate inhale effort and exhale release separately.
3. Phase — Which phase is working too hard?. Find Busy — find evidence.
4. Leave Timing — Ease only that side toward neutral—less pulling in or less pushing out—while leaving timing alone.
5. Check Whether — Check if urgency changes when imbalance decreases. Find Busy — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Check Whether.

items.goal: Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Let sound carry the exhale without squeezing it.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Take Ordinary — Take an ordinary inhale. Vibration Way — hear sound.
2. Leave Feeling — Hum at a soft, comfortable pitch as air leaves, feeling vibration in lips, face, or chest.
3. Stop Empty — Stop before empty. Vibration Way — name sensation.
4. Listen Silence — Listen to the silence after the hum, then decide whether another round would still feel kind. Vibration Way — next action.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Attention strengthens on the comeback, not the stay.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Select Neutral — Select one neutral anchor. Return Rep — loosen hands.
2. Attention — Each time distraction appears, notice where attention went and escort it back without commentary.
3. Count Rather — Count returns rather than uninterrupted seconds. Return Rep — allow opposite.
4. End After — Finish after ten honest comebacks, even if focus never felt perfect. Return Rep — next action.

⚡ FINISH — End After.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Remove identities without attacking experience.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Body — Notice body, sensation, thought, emotion, and role in turn. Still Here — breathe naturally.
2. Keep Perspective — For each say, ‘Observed—therefore not the whole observer.’ Do not claim they are unreal. Still Here — name sensation.
3. Rest Unlabelled — After the sequence, rest with what remains unlabelled, then reconnect to name and place. Still Here — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Rest Unlabelled.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Spiritual acceptance should not disguise preventable passivity.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Cannot — Name what cannot be changed today. Effort Still — move slowly.
2. Name Smallest — Beside it, name the smallest domain where effort remains possible.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The first start can be rehearsal; the second one becomes real.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Stage Door — Choose the opening movements: open the file, place the tool, find the line, or position your hands. Keep it under ten seconds. Run Start — loosen hands.
2. Dry Launch — Perform that sequence once without producing work. Stop at the edge of action; this is the dry launch.
3. Full Reset — Return your hands or screen to neutral exactly once. Leave the plan unchanged or add another rehearsal. Run Start — pick action.
4. Live Entry — Repeat the same sequence and continue straight into thirty seconds of real work. Run Start — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Live Entry.

1–2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Diversity need not become division.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Contrasting — Notice two contrasting experiences—pleasant and painful, self and other, sound and silence. Difference Inside — widen gaze.
2. Hold Distinct — Hold their distinct qualities without merging them.
3. Include Shared — Then include the shared field in which both are present. Difference Inside — notice detail.
4. Let Difference — Let difference remain vivid without translating it into separation. Difference Inside — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Difference.

items.name: MOVE THE HEAVIEST WORD
items.hook: Imagine: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
items.hook_internal: Imagine: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
items.game_move: PLAY: Say Alarm → Find Weight → Keep Signal
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Say Alarm → Find Weight → Keep Signal
items.goal: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
items.mission: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
items.challenge: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
items.immediate_need: Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Say Alarm — Choose the exact alarm sentence and shorten it to seven phrasing or fewer. Move Heaviest — feel support.
2. Shift Stress — Say it quietly several times, moving emphasis to one different word per round. Keep pitch and speed comfortable.
3. Find Weight — Notice which emphasis changes the meaning or body response most. Focus only on that word. Move Heaviest — notice detail.
4. Keep Signal — Keep the weighted word as information; stop the repetitions without debating the whole sentence. Move Heaviest — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Signal.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can move the emphasis and find where the sentence keeps its weight.
items.formula_flow: Say Alarm → Shift Stress → Find Weight → Keep Signal
items.safety:
PAUSE
Use silent emphasis if speaking is unsafe; stop for voice strain, breathing difficulty, or rising panic.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

GOAL
Not every distant scenario deserves a seat in this decision.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Ask Far — Ask how far ahead consequences can meaningfully alter today’s move: tonight, one week, six months. Today Furthest — feel support.
2. Imagine Line — Imagine a line at that horizon.
3. Park Scenario — Park every scenario beyond it unless it changes a present safety or commitment fact. Today Furthest — pick action.
4. Decide Information — Decide using information inside the line. Today Furthest — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Decide Information.

Attention belongs first to what can be known.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Sort Three Boxes — Picture three boxes: KNOWN, INFERRED, UNKNOWABLE. Come Back — feel support.
2. Move Claim — Move every claim about the other person into its correct box.
3. Choose Direct — Choose one direct question or boundary based on known facts. Come Back — split duty.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Let leftover readiness complete one harmless ending.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Find Readiness — While safely seated, locate one area that still feels ready to push, brace, turn, or withdraw. Finish Body — press feet.
2. Add Resistance — Choose a pain-free direction and add only light self-resistance.
3. Complete Slowly — Complete the movement slowly once, then release all effort rather than repeating it. Finish Body — name feeling.
4. Check Neutral — Compare resting pressure, movement range, and urge before and after. Finish Body — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Check Neutral.

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The body needs to know when available action is complete.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Remain Unknown — Name what you have already done, what remains unknown, and which outcomes no longer respond to effort. Point No — press feet.
2. Boundary — Notice the exact boundary where influence ends. Point No — allow opposite.
3. Use Physical — Use one physical closing action and redirect into a present responsibility. Point No — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Use Physical.

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Wrong mental mode makes effort repeat itself.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Decide Accept — Classify the demand as SOLVE, DECIDE, FEEL, ACCEPT, COMMUNICATE, or WAIT. Change Mental — widen gaze.
2. Name Mode — Name the mode currently running. Change Mental — pick action.
3. Choose Shut — Shut it down and perform the first action belonging to the correct mode—calculate, choose, allow, release, speak, or schedule. Change Mental — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Shut.
